orthogonalArray.strataConvention: half-open bins, with the exact endpoint 1 in the final bin

variationBounds.componentMoleFractions: every z_i in [0.8*z_i0,1.2*z_i0], sum(z)=1; all 20 treated equally
variationBounds.reboilerDutyWatts: 0..20% of Fbaseline*100000 J/mol; a nonzero reference is explicit because baseline duty is zero
variationBounds.paLocation: random distinct return/draw pairs, 1<=return<=draw<=N; all spans supported
variationBounds.paDuties: 80..120% of original three duties; fourth reference is their arithmetic mean
variationBounds.feedLocation: baseline normalized feed height times 0.8..1.2, clipped to 0..1 then rounded to an available tray

design.scope: Complete finite structural matrix and strength-2 latent continuous design; not exhaustive continuous-space, location-combination, mixture-simplex, or feasibility coverage.
design.admissionMeaning: No listed necessary condition failed; existence of a column solution remains undetermined.
design.qualification: Teacher nonconvergence is mapped separately and has no training target; numerical outcome never changes this frozen matrix or split.

preflightExclusions.meaning: Multiple exclusion reasons can apply to one row. Model-contract exclusions are not general physical impossibility.

summary.interpretation: Benchmark inputs were selected using design inputs only, before fitting. This is a serial warmed-JVM comparison; failed and unsupported attempts stay in denominators. Timing ratios compare the same inputs accepted by both methods and do not count fast rejection as a speedup. One run per input does not establish timing confidence intervals.

neuralFirstComparison.interpretation: LNN_FIRST includes prediction, attempted neural correction and any classical fallback within the same request. Its latency is not the standalone neural initialization cost.

unsupportedPriorFailures.reason: Legacy component axes do not match the model's registered 20-component basis. These cases are reported separately, without a padding/remapping claim.

model.architecture: global branch classifier + branch-conditioned shared two-hidden-layer stage MLP
model.component_treatment: All fractions variable; identical per-component target transformation
model.normalization_fitted_on: training columns only, equal total weight per column
model.selection_on: whole validation columns; no tray-level split
model.bounds_source: predeclared matrix input domain, without outcomes

selection.selectionRule: Highest equilibrium-qualified validation count, then native accepted count, then fewer parameters/iterations

finalPolicy.runtimeMode: LNN_FIRST with existing experts and classical fallback

selection.knownValidationLimits: No wet training labels; large profile-flow errors and failures on tall columns. The general model is an optional initializer, not a standalone replacement for classical initialization.

deployment.decisionBasis: Validation: 63/405 general native accepted versus 115/405 current, with weak tall-column coverage.
deployment.supersessionScope: Runtime packaging/selection only; no weight, feature, corrector, evaluation option, or original selection-record change.
deployment.evaluationMeaning: Fresh-general LNN_ONLY results describe the frozen direct model, not the default local experts or an ensemble.

archivedCaseMap.scope: Every finite-design input and latent vector, preflight disposition, original outcome and fresh-model outcome where evaluated. Unattempted predictions are explicitly marked evaluated=false. Full teacher profiles and original journals remain in build/neural-generalized with hashes in this card.
